fields.Name: Realtime Identity Verified
fields.Description: A person proved control of an email address during a realtime agent session (emailed link or typed code). Written by the realtime identity-verification service for the session's owner; RecordID is the AI Agent Session.

fields.Name: Realtime Agent Vision Consent
fields.Description: A person chose whether agents may see their camera and shared screen in a meeting room: allowed, or stopped allowing. Written by MJAPI when it sets the person's mj.agentCanSee LiveKit attribute, including when LiveKit refuses (Status Failed). UserID and RecordID are the person; Details carries the room and the choice.
